questions.text: मान लीजिए कि आप किसी संग्रहालय में जाते हैं और आपको हड़प्पा की मुहर मिलती है जिस पर एक बैल का चित्रण है। इससे हड़प्पा की मान्यताओं या प्रथाओं के बारे में क्या पता चलता है ?
questions.text_english: Assume you visit a museum and find a Harappan seal depicting a bull. What might this suggest about Harappan beliefs and practices ?

options.A: बैलों को सुरक्षा के लिए महत्त्वपूर्ण माना जाता था।
options.B: बैलों का संबंध ओमान के साथ युद्ध से था।
options.C: बैलों को धन का प्रतीक माना जाता था।
options.D: बैलों का प्रयोग कृषि में किया जाता था।

options_english.A: Bulls were considered important for protection.
options_english.B: Bulls were associated with warfare with Oman.
options_english.C: Bulls were considered as the symbol of wealth.
options_english.D: Bulls were usually used in agriculture.

questions.solution: The depiction of a bull on a Harappan seal suggests its importance in the agricultural society of the Harappans, as bulls were typically used in agricultural activities, reflecting their central role in the economy.
questions.chapter: Bricks, Beads and Bones: The Harappan Civilisation

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन 1944 में सेना के एक पूर्व ब्रिगेडियर और भारत के पुरातत्त्व सर्वेक्षण के महानिदेशक थे ?
questions.text_english: Who among the following was an ex-army Brigadier and Director General of the Archaeological Survey of India in 1944?
questions.solution: R.E.M. Wheeler, who was an ex-army Brigadier, became the Director General of the Archaeological Survey of India in 1944 and brought military precision to the archaeological excavations.
questions.chapter: Bricks, Beads and Bones: The Harappan Civilisation

questions.text: अभिकथन (A) : प्राचीन भारत में, गोत्र प्रणाली का उपयोग वंश का पता लगाने के लिए किया जाता था। कारण (R) : गोत्र एक बहिर्विवाह इकाई थी, जिसमें एक ही गोत्र में विवाह की अनुमति नहीं थी।
questions.text_english: Assertion (A): In ancient India, Gotra system was a way to trace lineage. Reason (R): Gotra was an exogamous unit, marriage within the same Gotra was not allowed.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु कारण (R) ग़लत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) ग़लत है, परन्तु कारण (R) सही है。

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Both the assertion and the reason are true. The Gotra system was indeed used to trace lineage, and since it was an exogamous unit, marriages within the same Gotra were prohibited, making the reason a correct explanation.
questions.chapter: Kinship, Caste and Class: Early Societies

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से बौद्ध ग्रंथों के संदर्भ में विषम युग्म की पहचान कीजिए :
questions.text_english: Find the odd one out from the following regarding the Buddhist texts :

options.B: सुत्त पिटक, अभिधम्म पिटक, विनय पिटक
options.D: उत्तराध्ययन सूत्र, सुत्त पिटक, विनय पिटक

options_english.B: Sutta Pitaka, Abhidhamma Pitaka, Vinaya Pitaka
options_english.D: Uttaradhyayana Sutta, Sutta Pitaka, Vinaya Pitaka

questions.solution: Option D is the odd one out because the 'Uttaradhyayana Sutta' is a canonical text of Jainism, whereas the other texts mentioned in this option, like the Sutta Pitaka and Vinaya Pitaka, are purely Buddhist.
questions.chapter: Thinkers, Beliefs and Buildings: Cultural Developments

questions.text: महाभारत से संबंधित स्तंभ I का स्तंभ II से मिलान कीजिए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Match Column I with Column II and choose the correct option with reference to Mahabharata.
questions.solution: The correct matches are: Yudhisthira (iii) Eldest of the Pandavas, Dhritarashtra (iv) Father of Duryodhana, Kunti (i) Mother of the Pandavas, and Gandhari (ii) Mother of the Kauravas. Thus, C is the correct option.
questions.chapter: Kinship, Caste and Class: Early Societies

questions.text: निम्नलिखित जानकारी की सहायता से प्राचीन भारत के शासक की पहचान कीजिए : वह गुप्त शासकों में सबसे शक्तिशाली था। वह कला और संस्कृत साहित्य का संरक्षक था। उसके लोग उसे देवताओं के बराबर मानते थे।
questions.text_english: Identify the ruler of ancient India with the help of following information: He was the most powerful of the Gupta rulers. He was a patron of art and Sanskrit literature. He was considered equal to the Gods by his people.
questions.solution: Samudragupta is widely regarded as the most powerful ruler of the Gupta dynasty. His extensive conquests and his patronage of arts and literature, along with the high status accorded to him in inscriptions, identify him as the correct answer.
questions.chapter: Kings, Farmers and Towns: Early States and Economies

questions.text: नीचे दिए गए चित्र के संदर्भ में, अशोक स्तंभ का सिंहशीर्ष कहाँ स्थित है ?
questions.text_english: In reference to the picture provided below, where is the lion capital of the Ashoka Pillar located?
questions.solution: The famous Lion Capital of Ashoka, which is now the National Emblem of India, was found at Sarnath, where Lord Buddha gave his first sermon.
questions.chapter: Kings, Farmers and Towns: Early States and Economies

questions.text: इब्न बतूता ने भारतीय कृषि को अत्यधिक उत्पादक क्यों पाया ? निम्नलिखित में से सर्वोपयुक्त कारण की पहचान कीजिए :
questions.text_english: Why did Ibn Battuta find Indian agriculture very productive? Identify the most appropriate reason from the following:

options.C: पूरे वर्ष वर्षा और मिट्टी की गुणवत्ता

options_english.C: Year round rainfall and soil quality

questions.solution: Ibn Battuta attributed the high productivity of Indian agriculture to the fertility of the soil, which allowed for cultivation twice a year, combined with effective irrigation systems.
questions.chapter: Through the Eyes of Travellers: Perceptions of Society

questions.text: कबीर ने 'निर्गुण भक्ति' पर बल दिया। कबीर की आध्यात्मिक मान्यताओं के बारे में यह अवधारणा क्या दर्शाती है ?
questions.text_english: Kabir emphasized 'Nirguna Bhakti'. What does this concept imply about Kabir's spiritual beliefs ?

options.A: वे गुणों वाले एक व्यक्तिगत ईश्वर में विश्वास रखते थे।
options.B: उन्होंने अनुष्ठानों और समारोहों के महत्त्व पर बल दिया।
options.C: उन्होंने ईश्वर और मनुष्यों के बीच एक पदानुक्रमिक संबंध को माना ।
options.D: वे ईश्वरीय एकता में विश्वास रखते थे।

options_english.A: He believed in a personal God with attributes.
options_english.B: He emphasized the importance of rituals and ceremonies.
options_english.C: He advocated for a hierarchical relation between God and humans.
options_english.D: He believed in the oneness of God.

questions.solution: Kabir's emphasis on 'Nirguna Bhakti' (devotion to a formless God) implies that he rejected idol worship and external rituals, instead believing in the oneness of God who is omnipresent and formless.
questions.chapter: Bhakti-Sufi Traditions: Changes in Religious Beliefs

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से विजयनगर साम्राज्य के संदर्भ में कौन-सा कथन सही है ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following is the correct statement regarding Vijayanagara Empire?

options.A: विजयनगर साम्राज्य की स्थापना 13वीं शताब्दी में हरिहर के द्वारा की गई थी।
options.B: विजयनगर, शहर और साम्राज्य दोनों का नाम था।
options.C: यह साम्राज्य कावेरी और तुंगभद्रा नदियों के बीच फैला हुआ था।
options.D: 15वीं शताब्दीं में विजयनगर खंडहर में बदल गया।

options_english.A: The Vijayanagara Empire was founded by Harihara in the 13th century.
options_english.B: Vijayanagara was the name of both, city and empire.
options_english.C: The empire stretched between rivers Kaveri and Tungabhadra.
options_english.D: Vijayanagara fell to ruins in the 15th century.

questions.solution: Vijayanagara was the name of both the city (capital) and the empire itself. It was established in the 14th century, not the 13th.
questions.chapter: An Imperial Capital: Vijayanagara

questions.text: स्तंभ I का स्तंभ II से मिलान कीजिए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Match Column I with Column II and choose the correct option.
questions.solution: The correct matches are: Muzarian (ii) Peasant, Patwari (i) Accountant, Majur (iii) Labourer, and Shroff (iv) Banker. Thus, C is the correct option.
questions.chapter: Peasants, Zamindars and the State: Agrarian Society

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कृष्णदेव राय का सबसे महत्त्वपूर्ण योगदान कौन-सा है ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following is the most important contribution of Krishnadeva Raya?

options.A: उन्होंने विजयनगर साम्राज्य का विस्तार किया।
options.B: उन्होंने मुगल शासकों को नियंत्रण में रखा।
options.C: सैन्य नियंत्रण को उन्होंने लचीला रखा।

options_english.C: He kept the military control flexible.

questions.solution: Krishnadeva Raya is best known for his successful military campaigns that greatly expanded the Vijayanagara Empire to its peak during his reign.
questions.chapter: An Imperial Capital: Vijayanagara

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से अमीर खुसरो के गुरु कौन थे ?
questions.text_english: Who among the following was the mentor of Amir Khusrau?
questions.solution: Amir Khusrau, the famous poet and musician, was a devoted disciple of the Sufi saint Shaikh Nizamuddin Auliya.
questions.chapter: Bhakti-Sufi Traditions: Changes in Religious Beliefs

questions.text: निम्नलिखित को कालानुक्रम में व्यवस्थित कीजिए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english: Arrange the following in chronological order and choose the correct option:
questions.solution: The chronological order is: IV. Al-Biruni (11th century), III. Ibn Battuta (14th century), II. Abd al-Razzaq (15th century), I. François Bernier (17th century). Thus, C is the correct sequence.
questions.chapter: Through the Eyes of Travellers: Perceptions of Society

questions.text: _______ की स्थापना ब्रिटिश सरकार ने 1875 में बॉम्बे और दक्कन में ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी की भूमिका और आर्थिक संकट की जाँच के लिए की थी।
questions.text_english: The _______ was established by the British government in 1875 to investigate the economic distress and role of East India Company in Bombay and the Deccan.
questions.solution: The correct answer is the Deccan Riots Commission, which was formed to investigate the socio-economic causes of the riots in the Deccan region in 1875.
questions.chapter: Colonialism and the Countryside

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा 1859 में अंग्रेजों द्वारा पारित 'परिसीमन कानून' का प्रावधान नहीं था ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following was not the provision of the 'Limitation Law' passed by the British in 1859?

options.A: साहूकारों और रैयतों के बीच हस्ताक्षरित ऋणपत्र (बांड) की वैधता तीन वर्ष होगी।
options.B: कानून का उद्देश्य समय के साथ ब्याज के संचय की जाँच करना था।
options.C: साहूकारों और रैयतों के बीच प्रत्येक तीन वर्ष में ऋणपत्र (बांड) को नवीनीकृत किया जाता था।
options.D: रैयतों को बिचौलियों के रूप में जमीन का मालिकाना हक़ दे दिया गया था।

options_english.A: The loan bonds signed between the money-lenders and ryots would have validity of three years.
options_english.B: The law was to check the accumulation of interest over time.
options_english.C: The money-lenders and ryots used to renew the bonds after every three years.
options_english.D: Ryots were given permanent stakes in land as interlopers.

questions.solution: The Limitation Law of 1859 intended to regulate debt bonds by limiting their validity to three years, but it did not grant ryots land ownership rights as interlopers; in fact, it often worked against the ryots' interests.
questions.chapter: Colonialism and the Countryside

questions.text: अंग्रेज अवध क्षेत्र का अधिग्रहण क्यों करना चाहते थे ? निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english: Why were the British keen to annex the territory of Awadh ? Choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: अवध में राष्ट्रवादी आंदोलन को दबाने के लिए।
options.B: अवध के समृद्ध संसाधनों को पाने के लिए।
options.C: भारत के पश्चिमी भाग पर नियंत्रण मज़बूत करने के लिए।
options.D: अंग्रेजों का मध्य भारत में सैन्य नियंत्रण बढ़ाने के लिए।

options_english.A: To suppress the nationalist movement in Awadh.
options_english.B: To get access to Awadh's rich resources.
options_english.C: To strengthen their control in the west in India.
options_english.D: To enhance British military control in Central India.

questions.solution: The British were primarily interested in annexing Awadh due to its vast, fertile lands and rich economic resources, which made it a highly desirable territory for colonial expansion.
questions.chapter: Rebels and the Raj: 1857 Revolt

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से सिंहभूम के उस स्थानीय नेता की पहचान कीजिए जिसने 1857 के विद्रोह में किसानों को शामिल करने का नेतृत्व किया।
questions.text_english: From the following identify, the local leader of Singhbhum who led the cultivators to join the Revolt of 1857.
questions.solution: Gonoo was the local leader from Singhbhum who mobilized the tribal cultivators and led them to participate in the widespread revolt of 1857.
questions.chapter: Rebels and the Raj: 1857 Revolt

questions.text: स्तंभ I का स्तंभ II से मिलान कीजिए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Match Column I with Column II and choose the correct option.
questions.solution: The correct matches are: Ho Chi Minh (iv) Struggle to free Vietnam, J.M. Garibaldi (iii) The unification of Italy, George Washington (i) American war of independence, and Clement Attlee (ii) British withdrawal from India. Thus, B is correct.
questions.chapter: Framing the Constitution

questions.text: काँग्रेस का 1929 लाहौर अधिवेशन क्यों महत्त्वपूर्ण था ? निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english: Why was the 1929 Lahore Session of Congress significant? Choose the correct option from the following:
questions.solution: The 1929 Lahore Session of the Congress was historic because it passed the resolution for 'Purna Swaraj' or complete independence from British rule.
questions.chapter: Mahatma Gandhi and the Nationalist Movement

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से संविधान सभा की सलाहकार समिति के नेता कौन थे ?
questions.text_english: Who amongst the following was the leader of the Advisory Committee of the Constituent Assembly?
questions.solution: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel was the head of the Advisory Committee on Fundamental Rights, Minorities and Tribal and Excluded Areas in the Constituent Assembly.
questions.chapter: Framing the Constitution

questions.text: (क) प्राचीन भारत में धर्मसूत्रों और धर्मशास्त्रों में संहिताबद्ध क्षत्रियों द्वारा किए जाने वाले कार्यों की परख कीजिए। OR (ख) प्राचीन भारत में वर्ण व्यवस्था के नियमों का पालन करवाने के लिए ब्राह्मणों द्वारा अपनाए गए किन्हीं तीन तरीकों की परख कीजिए।
questions.text_english: (a) Examine the duties to be performed by Kshatriyas as codified in Dharmasutras and Dharmashastras in the ancient India. OR (b) Examine any three ways evolved by Brahmanas to enforce the norms of the Varna order in the ancient India.

sub_questions.text: क्षत्रियों के कार्यों का वर्णन करें।
sub_questions.solution: According to the Dharmasutras and Dharmashastras, the duties of the Kshatriyas included engaging in warfare, protecting the people, administering justice, studying the Vedas, getting sacrifices performed, and making gifts. They were ordained to be the rulers and protectors of society.

questions.solution: The Dharmashastras assigned specific duties to Kshatriyas, primarily focusing on governance and defense. They were tasked with studying the Vedas, performing sacrifices, and giving gifts. Crucially, they were meant to protect subjects and administer justice, maintaining law and order while upholding the social framework of the varna system.
questions.chapter: Kinship, Caste and Class: Early Societies

questions.text: हड़प्पावासियों की धार्मिक मान्यताओं पर पुरातत्त्वविदों के विचारों की व्याख्या कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Explain the views of archaeologists on the religious beliefs of the Harappans.

key_points: Importance of nature worship and sacred symbols.

questions.solution: Archaeologists have inferred Harappan religious beliefs from artifacts like terracotta figurines, which suggest the worship of a Mother Goddess. The discovery of the 'proto-Shiva' seal with a seated figure surrounded by animals indicates early traditions of asceticism or deity worship. Furthermore, the presence of sacred symbols, including trees and animals, points to a nature-based spiritual belief system prevalent among the people.
questions.chapter: Bricks, Beads and Bones: The Harappan Civilisation

questions.text: (क) मुगल भारत में यात्रा के दौरान बर्नियर द्वारा प्रदान की गई टिप्पणियों, आलोचनात्मक अंतर्दृष्टि और चिंतन का विश्लेषण कीजिए। OR (ख) इब्न बतूता के वृत्तांतों से उस समय के भारतीय समाज की महत्त्वपूर्ण जानकारी मिलती है। इस कथन को न्यायसंगत ठहराइए।
questions.text_english: (a) Analyse the observations, critical insights and reflections provided by Bernier while he travelled in Mughal India. OR (b) Ibn Battuta's accounts provide important insights into the Indian society of that time.Justify the statement.

sub_questions.text: बर्नियर की मुगल भारत पर टिप्पणी।
sub_questions.solution: François Bernier, a French traveller, wrote critically about Mughal India. He emphasized the 'lack of private property in land' as a key difference from Europe, claiming it led to the impoverishment of peasants and discouraged long-term land improvements by the nobility, viewing it as a degenerate system.

questions.solution: Bernier's travelogues provide a distinctive, often critical European perspective on the Mughal administration. He famously described the 'crown ownership of land' as a fundamental flaw, arguing it prevented the development of a stable middle class. His accounts reflect his belief that such systems led to the poor condition of peasants and lack of investment, contrasting it with contemporary European socio-economic structures.
questions.chapter: Through the Eyes of Travellers: Perceptions of Society

questions.text: विजयनगर का विठ्ठल मंदिर अपनी अनूठी वास्तुकला के लिए जाना जाता था ।इस कथन की उदाहरणों सहित व्याख्या कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: The Vitthala temple of Vijayanagara was known for its unique architecture. Explain the statement with examples.
questions.solution: The Vitthala temple is celebrated for its remarkable architectural style, particularly its intricately carved pillars, some of which produce musical notes when tapped. Another iconic feature is the stone chariot located in the temple courtyard, which represents the immense craftsmanship and artistic innovation prevalent during the Vijayanagara Empire.
questions.chapter: An Imperial Capital: Vijayanagara

questions.text: 1924 से 1928 तक गाँधीजी की भारतीय राजनीति में मुख्य गतिविधियों की परख कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Examine the major activities of Gandhiji in Indian politics from 1924 to 1928.
questions.solution: During 1924-1928, Gandhiji largely withdrew from active mass political agitation to focus on constructive work. He traveled extensively across India to promote the use of Khadi (hand-spun cloth), encourage Hindu-Muslim unity, and advocate for the removal of untouchability, aiming to strengthen the national movement from the grassroots level.
questions.chapter: Mahatma Gandhi and the Nationalist Movement

questions.text: रैयतवाड़ी व्यवस्था की किन्हीं तीन विशेषताओं का वर्णन कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: Describe any three features of the Ryotwari system.
questions.solution: The Ryotwari system was characterized by three main features: first, the land revenue settlement was made directly with the individual cultivator (ryot) rather than with intermediaries or zamindars. Second, the revenue rates were fixed for a specific period and could be adjusted thereafter. Third, the state held the ultimate claim to land ownership in this arrangement.
questions.chapter: Colonialism and the Countryside

questions.text: (क) “बुद्ध को अपने समय के सबसे प्रभावशाली शिक्षकों में से एक माना जाता था।” इस कथन के प्रकाश में उनकी शिक्षाओं की व्याख्या कीजिए। OR (ख) प्राचीन भारत में पौराणिक हिंदू धर्म की विशेषताओं की व्याख्या कीजिए।
questions.text_english: (a) The Buddha was considered as one of the most influential teachers of his times. In the light of this statement, explain his teachings. OR (b) Explain the features of Puranic Hinduism in ancient India.

sub_questions.text: बुद्ध की शिक्षाओं का विस्तार से वर्णन करें।
sub_questions.text_english: Describe the teachings of Buddha in detail.
sub_questions.solution: The Buddha's teachings were revolutionary, focusing on logic and personal experience rather than blind faith. He preached the Four Noble Truths, which center on the reality of suffering, its cause (desire), and the path to ending it. His Eightfold Path provided a practical guide for ethical living. He rejected the caste system and rituals, emphasizing equality, non-violence (ahimsa), and compassion, making his message deeply influential for ordinary people.

questions.solution: Buddha's influence stemmed from his accessible teachings which challenged established orthodoxies. He emphasized that the world is transient and sorrowful. The Four Noble Truths taught that suffering is caused by craving. By following the Eightfold Path, individuals could achieve Nirvana, the cessation of suffering. He spoke in Prakrit, the language of the people, rather than the elite Sanskrit, making his message egalitarian and accessible. His rejection of complex rituals and the varna hierarchy resonated with the masses, profoundly shaping the cultural and religious landscape of ancient India for centuries.
questions.chapter: Thinkers, Beliefs and Buildings: Cultural Developments

questions.text: (क) मुगल कृषिक समाज में महिलाओं की भूमिका महत्त्वपूर्ण थी।उदाहरण देते हुए इस कथन की व्याख्या कीजिए। OR (ख) “आइन-ए-अकबरी मुगल साम्राज्य का एक असाधारण दस्तावेज़ है।उदाहरण देते हुए इस कथन की व्याख्या कीजिए।
questions.text_english: (a) The role of women in the Mughal agrarian society was significant.Explain the statement giving examples. OR (b) The Ain-i-Akbari is an extraordinary document of the Mughal Empire.Explain the statement giving examples.

sub_questions.text: मुगल कृषिक समाज में महिलाओं का योगदान समझाएं।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain the contribution of women in Mughal agrarian society.
sub_questions.solution: In Mughal agrarian society, women were integral to the household economy. They performed essential tasks such as spinning yarn, kneading clay for pottery, and helping in the fields during sowing and harvesting. Their work was not just domestic; it was essential for maintaining the family livelihood and contributing to the rural production cycle.

questions.solution: Women in Mughal agrarian societies played a vital, though often understated, role in economic production. They were actively involved in post-harvest activities and field labor. Beyond the fields, they were responsible for managing the domestic sphere, ensuring family sustenance. Historical records highlight that their labor was essential for the production process. While they faced societal constraints, their participation was foundational to the rural agrarian setup, demonstrating that their role went far beyond domestic chores and was a crucial component of the agricultural economy of the time.
questions.chapter: Peasants, Zamindars and the State: Agrarian Society

questions.text: (क) केन्द्र और राज्यों के बीच शक्ति के बँटवारे पर संविधान सभा के सदस्यों के विचारों का वर्णन कीजिए। OR (ख) संविधान सभा में जवाहरलाल नेहरू द्वारा 'उद्देश्य प्रस्ताव' में व्यक्त आदर्शों का वर्णन कीजिए।
questions.text_english: (a) Describe the views of the members of the Constituent Assembly on division of powers between the Centre and the States. OR (b) Describe the ideals expressed in the 'Objectives Resolution' by Jawaharlal Nehru in the Constituent Assembly.

sub_questions.text: केंद्र और राज्य शक्तियों के विभाजन पर चर्चा करें।
sub_questions.text_english: Discuss the division of powers between Centre and States.
sub_questions.solution: In the Constituent Assembly, members engaged in intense debates regarding the distribution of powers between the Centre and the States. There was a strong consensus for a powerful Centre to ensure national unity, given the trauma of Partition. However, many members also advocated for strong state powers to allow for regional development and local governance. K. Santhanam argued for more fiscal powers for the states, while others feared that excessive state power could lead to instability, ultimately resulting in the Union, State, and Concurrent lists.

questions.solution: The Constituent Assembly debate on the division of powers was central to India's federal structure. The memory of Partition led many members to favor a strong Central government to maintain unity and national integration. They felt that a weak Centre would invite chaos. Simultaneously, members like K. Santhanam expressed concerns that states would be starved of resources if all fiscal authority remained with the Centre. The resulting compromise led to the tripartite system of lists (Union, State, and Concurrent). This structure aimed to balance the need for a cohesive national authority with the practical necessity of giving states sufficient autonomy to function effectively.
questions.chapter: Framing the Constitution

questions.text:
राजा की वेदना

जब देवानांपिय पियदस्सी ने अपने शासन के आठ वर्ष पूरे किए तो उन्होंने कलिंग (आधुनिक तटवर्ती उड़ीसा) पर विजय प्राप्त की।

डेढ़ लाख पुरुषों को निष्कासित किया गया; एक लाख मारे गए और इससे भी ज़्यादा की मृत्यु हुई।

कलिंग पर शासन स्थापित करने के बाद देवानांपिय धम्म के गहन अध्ययन, धम्म के स्नेह और धम्म के उपदेश में डूब गए हैं।

यही देवानांपिय के लिए कलिंग की विजय का पश्चाताप है।

देवानांपिय के लिए यह बहुत वेदनादायी और निंदनीय है कि जब कोई किसी राज्य पर विजय प्राप्त करता है तो पराजित राज्य का हनन होता है, वहाँ लोग मारे जाते हैं, निष्कासित किए जाते हैं।
questions.text_english:
The Anguish of the King

When the king Devanampiya Piyadassi had been ruling for eight years, the (country of the) Kalingas (present-day coastal Orissa) was conquered by (him).

One hundred and fifty thousand men were deported, a hundred thousand were killed, and many more died.

After that, now that (the country of) the Kalingas has been taken, Devanampiya (is devoted) to an intense study of Dhamma, to the love of Dhamma, and to instructing (the people) in Dhamma.

This is the repentance of Devanampiya on account of his conquest of the (country of the) Kalingas.

For this is considered very painful and deplorable by Devanampiya that, while one is conquering an unconquered (country) slaughter, death and deportation of people (take place) there...

sub_questions.text: राजा देवानांपिय पियदस्सी की कलिंग विजय ने उनके शासन के दृष्टिकोण को किस प्रकार प्रभावित किया ?
sub_questions.text_english: How did king Devanampiya Piyadassi's conquest of Kalinga influence his approach to governance?
sub_questions.solution: The mass slaughter and suffering witnessed during the Kalinga war caused the king immense pain and remorse, leading him to abandon the policy of aggressive conquest for the pursuit of 'Dhamma'.

sub_questions.text: कलिंग विजय ने प्रजा के प्रति राजा के व्यवहार को किस प्रकार बदल दिया ?
sub_questions.text_english: How did Kalinga's conquest change the king's actions towards his subjects?
sub_questions.solution: The king's actions shifted from expansionist warfare to promoting the welfare of his subjects, focusing on the principles of Dhamma rather than violence.

sub_questions.text: राजा के परिवर्तन ने धम्म के प्रसार को किस प्रकार आकार दिया ?
sub_questions.text_english: How did the king's transformation shape the spread of Dhamma?
sub_questions.solution: The king's personal transformation led him to make the propagation of Dhamma his primary duty, dedicating himself to its intense study, love, and instruction, which became the cornerstone of his governance.

questions.chapter: Kings, Farmers and Towns: Early States and Economies

questions.text:
शाही भेंट अस्वीकार

यह उद्धरण सूफ़ी ग्रंथ से है जो शेख निज़ामुद्दीन औलिया की ख़ानक़ाह में 1313 में हुई घटना का वर्णन करता है :

मेरी (अमीर हसन सिजज़ी) अच्छी किस्मत थी कि मैं उनके (निज़ामुद्दीन औलिया) कदम चूम सका... इस समय एक स्थानीय शासक ने दो बगीचे और बहुत सी ज़मीन का पट्टा शेख साहब को भेजा है। साथ ही इनके रखरखाव के लिए औज़ार व आवश्यक वस्तुएँ भेजी हैं। शासक ने यह भी साफ किया है कि वह बगीचों और ज़मीन पर अपना हक कहते हैं: इस ज़मीन, खेत और बगीचे का मुझे क्या करना है ?... हमारे कोई भी आध्यात्मिक गुरु ने इस तरह का काम नहीं किया।

फिर उन्होंने एक उचित कहानी सुनाई ... सुल्तान गियासुद्दीन जो उस समय उलुग खान के नाम से जाने जाते थे, शेख फ़रीदुद्दीन से मिलने आए। उन्होंने शेख को कुछ धनराशि और चार गाँवों का पट्टा भेंट किया । धन दरवेशों के लिए था और ज़मीन शेख के अपने इस्तेमाल के लिए थी । मुस्कुराते हुए शेख-अल-इस्लाम (फ़रीदुद्दीन) ने कहा: मुझे धन दे दो मैं इसे दरवेशों में बाँट दूँगा, पर जहाँ तक ज़मीन के पट्टे का सवाल है उसे उन लोगों को दे दो जिन्हें उनकी कामना है....।
questions.text_english:
Declining a royal gift

This excerpt from a sufi text describes the proceedings at Shaikh Nizamuddin Auliya's hospice in 1313:

I (the author, Amir Hasan Sijzi) had the good fortune of kissing his (Shaikh Nizamuddin Auliya's) feet At this time a local ruler had sent him the deed of ownership to two gardens and much land, along with the provisions and tools for their maintenance.

The ruler had also made it clear that he was relinquishing all his rights to both the gardens and land.

The master had not accepted that gift. Instead, he had lamented: What have I to do with gardens and fields and lands? None of ... our spiritual masters had engaged in such activity.

Then he told an appropriate story: ... Sultan Ghiyasuddin, who at that time was still known as Ulugh Khan, came to visit Shaikh Fariduddin (and) offered some money and ownership deeds for four villages to the Shaikh, the money being for the benefit of the dervishes (sufis), and the land for his use. Smiling, Shaikh al Islam (Fariduddin) said: 'Give me the money. I will dispense it to the dervishes. But as for those land deeds, keep them. There are many who long for them. Give them away to such persons.

sub_questions.text: राजा ने शेख निज़ामुद्दीन औलिया को क्या प्रस्ताव दिया ?
sub_questions.text_english: What did the ruler offer Shaikh Nizamuddin Auliya ?
sub_questions.solution: The local ruler offered Shaikh Nizamuddin Auliya the ownership deed of two gardens and a significant amount of land, along with tools for their maintenance.

sub_questions.text: शेख ने भूमि के पट्टे लेने से इंकार करने का क्या कारण दिया ?
sub_questions.text_english: What reason did the Shaikh give for refusing the land deeds?
sub_questions.solution: The Shaikh refused the land deeds because he stated that none of his spiritual predecessors had engaged in owning land or agricultural activities, and it was contrary to his ascetic practice.

sub_questions.text: शेख की प्रतिक्रिया सूफ़ी मूल्यों को किस प्रकार प्रतिबिंबित करती है ?
sub_questions.text_english: How does the response of the Shaikh reflect the Sufi values ?
sub_questions.solution: The Shaikh's response reflects the Sufi value of detachment from material wealth and worldly power. It highlights the ascetic lifestyle and the emphasis on spiritual enrichment over ownership or luxury.

questions.chapter: Bhakti-Sufi Traditions: Changes in Religious Beliefs

questions.text:
ताल्लुक़दारों की सोच

ताल्लुक़दारों के रवैये को रायबरेली के पास स्थित कालाकंकर के राजा हनवन्त सिंह ने सबसे अच्छी तरह व्यक्त किया था। विद्रोह के दौरान हनवन्त सिंह ने एक अंग्रेज अफ़सर को पनाह दी और उसे सुरक्षित स्थान तक पहुँचाया था।

उस अफ़सर से आख़िरी मुलाकात में हनवन्त सिंह ने कहा कि साहिब, आपके मुल्क के लोग हमारे देश में आए और उन्होंने हमारे राजाओं को खदेड़ दिया। आप अफ़सरों को भेज कर जिले-जिले में जागीरों के मालिकाने की जाँच करवाते हैं। एक ही झटके में आपने मेरे पुरखों की ज़मीन मुझसे छीन ली। मैं चुप रहा।

फिर अचानक आपका बुरा वक़्त शुरू हो गया। भूमि के लोग आपके ख़िलाफ़ उठ खड़े हुए। तब आप मेरे पास आए, जिसे आपने बर्बाद किया था । मैंने आपकी जान बचाई है। लेकिन अब, अब मैं अपने सिपाहियों को लेकर लखनऊ जा रहा हूँ ताकि आपको देश से खदेड़ सकूँ ।
questions.text_english:
What taluqdars thought

The attitude of the taluqdars was best expressed by Hanwant Singh, the Raja of Kalakankar, near Rae Bareli.

During the mutiny, Hanwant Singh had given shelter to a British officer, and conveyed him to safety.

While taking leave of the officer, Hanwant Singh told him:

Sahib, your countrymen came into this country and drove out our King. You sent your officers round the districts to examine the titles to the estates. At one blow you took from me lands which from time immemorial had been in my family. I submitted.

Suddenly misfortune fell upon you. The people of the land rose against you. You came to me whom you had despoiled. I have saved you.

But now now I march at the head of my retainers to Lucknow to try and drive you from the country.

sub_questions.text: हनवन्त सिंह ने अंग्रेजों के प्रति अपना असंतोष कैसे व्यक्त किया ?
sub_questions.text_english: How did Hanwant Singh express his dissatisfaction towards the British ?
sub_questions.solution: Hanwant Singh expressed his dissatisfaction by recounting how the British had usurped his ancestral lands through land title examinations, effectively stripping him of his heritage.

sub_questions.text: हनवन्त सिंह ने 'भूमि के लोग' किसे कहा ?
sub_questions.text_english: Who did Hanwant Singh refer to as the people of the land
sub_questions.solution: Hanwant Singh referred to the local populace, the common people who had revolted against the British, as 'the people of the land'.

sub_questions.text: हनवन्त सिंह का कथन ताल्लुक़दारों की भावनाओं को कैसे दर्शाता है ?
sub_questions.text_english: How did Hanwant Singh's statement reflect the sentiments of the taluqdars?
sub_questions.solution: His statement reflects the deep sense of betrayal and resentment felt by taluqdars, whose traditional rights and lands had been destroyed by colonial administrative policies, driving them to join the rebellion.

questions.chapter: Rebels and the Raj: 1857 Revolt

questions.text: (34.1) भारत के दिए गए राजनीतिक रेखा-मानचित्र (पृष्ठ 23 पर) में, निम्नलिखित को उपयुक्त चिह्नों से अंकित कीजिए और उनके नाम लिखिए : (i) लोथल - एक विकसित हड़प्पा स्थल (ii) अमरावती - बौद्ध स्थल (iii) (क) आगरा - मुगलों के अधीन क्षेत्र अथवा (iii) (ख) पानीपत – मुगलों के अधीन क्षेत्र (34.2) भारत के इसी राजनीतिक रेखा-मानचित्र पर 1857 के दौरान ब्रिटिश नियंत्रण के अधीन दो स्थानों को A और B से अंकित किया गया है। इनकी पहचान कीजिए और उनके सही नाम उनके निकट खींची गई रेखाओं पर लिखिए।
questions.text_english: (34.1) On the given political outline map of India (on page 23), locate and label the following with appropriate symbols : (i) Lothal - A Mature Harappan site (ii) Amravati - A Buddhist site (iii) (a) Agra - A territory under the Mughals OR (iii) (b) Panipat - A territory under the Mughals (34.2) On the same political outline map of India, two places which were under the control of British during 1857 have been marked as A and B. Identify them and write their names on the lines drawn near them.
questions.solution: This is a map-based question. 34.1: (i) Lothal (Gujarat), (ii) Amravati (Andhra Pradesh), (iii) Agra/Panipat (Northern India). 34.2: Location A refers to Calcutta/Bengal region, and Location B refers to Delhi/Meerut region (as per standard historical map markings of 1857).
questions.chapter: Multiple Chapters
